notes.title: Update on the Release of Designated Driver
notes.content:
Announcement: Update on the Release of Designated Driver

To our valued gamers who have been waiting for Designated Driver, we sincerely apologize for the delay in the release.

During the final stages of testing, we discovered areas that required further improvements and decided to include additional development work. To provide a better experience, we are also expanding support to include more languages.

We are now aiming to launch within October, and we truly appreciate your patience and support as we work to deliver the best possible version of Designated Driver.
